audit.provably_unservable_rule: Optimistic Manhattan travel from actual vehicle states, ignoring blocks, meals, stock, service, return and other orders. Failing for every fixed-fleet vehicle is a necessary-condition certificate. Orders not excluded by this bound are NOT proven servable.
audit.interpretation: Planning output, not observed delivery execution. Missing orders are NOT a mathematical infeasibility certificate.
